changelogs.title: Dark Mode & Performance 2.0
changelogs.content: We revamped the entire theme system to support automatic OS dark mode and reduced bundle size by 42%.

changelogs.title: Instant Webhook Notifications
changelogs.content: Receive real-time alerts directly in your Slack or Discord channels when critical events occur.

changelogs.title: Fixed CSV Export Encoding Bug
changelogs.content: Resolved an issue where accented UTF-8 characters were garbled in Excel spreadsheet exports.

roadmap.title: Multi-workspace & Team Roles
roadmap.description: Invite team members with Admin, Editor, and Viewer permissions.

roadmap.title: Zapier & Make.com Native Integration
roadmap.description: Trigger workflows automatically without writing custom API webhooks.

roadmap.title: SOC2 & HIPAA Compliance Reports
roadmap.description: Export audit logs and compliance certifications directly from settings.

roadmap.title: Custom Subdomains & SSL
